universe: All Trusts weights each reporting trust by its receivables, so the largest trusts weigh most; a month is shown only once at least 3 trusts holding at least 80% of receivables have reported it, and charge-offs use net rates only.

Figures are the trust's own, as its servicer reports them each month on SEC Form 10-D; trusts define them differently (Methodology §11 lists each trust's definition), so compare trends more than levels.
